Variable default value in EcucIntegerParamDef The attribute defaultValue of EcucIntegerParamDef is subject to variant handling. The value can be computed using the variant handling mechanism.

Variable min, max values in EcucFloatParamDef The attributes min and max of EcucFloatParamDef are subject to variant handling. The values can be computed using the variant handling mechanism.

requiresIndex setting in the VSMD The requiresIndex setting may be changed in the VSMD.
